turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Yes! Here is an example with each step.
I start work at nine. My dad starts work at nine. Step 1: who? My dad = he. Step 2: he means add -s, so start becomes starts.
Rule: with he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
The shop opens at eight is right. The shop open at eight is wrong.

Now you. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
